Not extracted: Global Gateway's 'digital development' (a list of investment areas, incidental), the EUPM cyber and hybrid threats bullet (security mission, incidental, as for hybrid threat items elsewhere), and the background on the accession process, funding, trade, energy and people-to-people contacts.
